output.text: ["Find the area of triangle APB and triangle CPD given that their sum equals the sum of the areas of triangles BPC and APD, and use the given side lengths to determine the relationship between the diagonals.", "Use the condition that the sum of the areas of triangles APB and CPD equals the sum of the areas of triangles BPC and APD to deduce that the diagonals bisect each other in terms of area, implying that point P is such that the diagonals divide the quadrilateral into four triangles with equal area sums on opposite pairs.", "Compute the total area of quadrilateral ABCD by leveraging symmetry and the given side lengths, using the fact that the area condition implies that the diagonals intersect in a way that balances the areas, and apply the formula for area using side lengths and properties of quadrilaterals with equal opposite area sums."]
